programs.provenance: Locally authored additive generic-array output batching and bounded ALU traversal of the pinned optimized source; original compact/optimized sources and evidence preserved.
adaptations: Canonical ALU and 2n/3n/5n lengths, unscaled binary64 cumulative probabilities and direct seed/139968 division for each random draw. Compact performs sequential RNG updates; optimized computes all chunk transitions with an ordinary affine prefix scan. No RNG-period cache.
Construct all 60-character line endings with native array arithmetic and gather, then issue one ordinary stdout Write per bounded chunk.
Traverse ALU in the same bounded line-aligned chunks while carrying the global character offset; retain every requested character and all headers.
Preserve the random-generation block byte for byte; exhaustive CDF validation is probe-only and supplies no production lookup table.

algorithm.reason: The unchanged generic affine scan generates every LCG draw and unscaled binary64 CDF comparison; native gather batches exact output and retains global ALU phase.

programs.loc_review: Every independent binding, datatype declaration and function-body line is counted; all formatter and ALU chunk helpers are included. No packed-binding discount.

additive_migration_policy: Preserve original/frozen evidence and retain both original compact and optimized candidates and measurements. This additional candidate does not replace either endpoint or select/refreeze programs; explicit admission and fresh full candidate/control measurements are required, and actual results determine eventual endpoints.
